$description: vd3 design tokens — NORMATIVE single source of truth. W3C DTCG format. VALUES AUDITED against @vanduo-oss/vd3@1.9.0 (dist/tokens.json, vd3-core.css, vd3.css) — see docs/token-audit.md. Structure and naming are binding; public CSS names follow v1.9 verbatim (see conventions/naming.md mapping table). Generated CSS in library repos MUST match this file (CI check). Basis classes: A = phi/Fibonacci/Lucas-derived, B = conventional-by-design (written reason), C = registered exception (foundations/proportion.md registry).

math.$description: Core mathematical constants derived from the Golden Ratio (phi = (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2). Class A.

sqrt-phi.$description: Square root of golden ratio sqrt(phi) - typography modular step multiplier

golden-angle.$description: Golden angle in degrees: 360 * (1 - 1/phi). Dimensionless number in DTCG; CSS/Figma consumers append 'deg' (--vd3-golden-angle: 137.507764deg).

primitive.$description: Raw palette scales — v1.9 values (Open Color baseline: --vd-gray-*, --vd-yellow-*, --vd-red-*; Fibonacci golden-angle palette: --vd-fib-* / --vd-golden-*). Never consumed by components directly.

gold.$description: v1.9 Open Color yellow family (--vd-yellow-*), the default light primary (amber).

vd3.reason: Open Color yellow interactive hover state
Open Color red dark mode critical role
Open Color red critical error baseline

golden-angle.$description: Algorithmic golden-angle palette (H_k = (43 + k * 137.508) mod 360) generating maximally dispersed categorical hues. Class A.

role.$description: Semantic roles — default (light) theme, v1.9-audited. Components consume ONLY these. Dark theme: theme.dark.color.role MUST define every role. Public CSS names follow v1.9 (--vd-bg-primary, --vd-text-primary, --vd-border-color, --vd-color-primary, --vd-color-error).

canvas-rgb.$description: RGB channel triplet of color.role.canvas for rgba() compositing · --vd3-color-canvas-rgb

vd3.reason: RGB channel triplet of semantic canvas color

focus.$description: v1.9 --vd-color-primary (default light primary = amber). v1.9 has NO dedicated focus-geometry tokens — ring width/offset are the F3-7 gap, new in 1.0.

focus-glow.$description: v1.9 --vd3-color-focus-glow (light). Halo ink for the dual-ring glow. NEW as a role in 1.0.2 (previously CSS-only).

vd3.reason: Alpha-blended focus halo matching focus role

info.$description: Semantic status info accent (golden-angle step 1); pair with text-primary or darkened mix on light surfaces · --vd3-color-info

vd3.reason: Semantic status info accent mapped to golden-angle step 1; light-surface text requires darkening or text-primary pairing

success.$description: Semantic status success accent (golden-angle step 6); pair with text-primary or darkened mix on light surfaces · --vd3-color-success

vd3.reason: Semantic status success accent mapped to golden-angle step 6; light-surface text requires darkening or text-primary pairing

warning.$description: Semantic status warning accent (gold.6); pair with text-primary or darkened mix on light surfaces · --vd3-color-warning

vd3.reason: Semantic status warning accent; light-surface text requires darkening or text-primary pairing

shadow.$description: Shadow ink, light theme (dark uses #0000004d). v1.9 fib shadows bake hex-alpha literals.

role.$description: Dark theme — v1.9 [data-theme="dark"] block values. MUST define every role from color.role.

canvas-rgb.$description: RGB channel triplet of dark canvas (gray.9) · --vd3-color-canvas-rgb

vd3.reason: RGB channel triplet of dark semantic canvas color
Dark mode focus halo (parity with light role)

info.$description: Dark mode semantic status info accent (6.09:1 on dark canvas) · --vd3-color-info

vd3.reason: Dark mode semantic status info accent

success.$description: Dark mode semantic status success accent (6.55:1 on dark canvas) · --vd3-color-success

vd3.reason: Dark mode semantic status success accent

warning.$description: Dark mode semantic status warning accent (10.82:1 on dark canvas) · --vd3-color-warning

vd3.reason: Dark mode semantic status warning accent

shadow.$description: Dark theme elevation shadows with elevated opacity — [data-theme="dark"] block values.

space.$description: ONE normative spacing scale, rem on a 16px base — v1.9 --vd-space-fib-*, 11/11 match. Names are Fibonacci numbers. Values <= 12px follow registered exception C-01 (rem-rounded 2/4/6/8/12); literal from 13px. v1.9 also ships --vd-spacing-* (literal Fibonacci px — same values in px) and --vd-space-* (4px-based conventional utility scale, class B); both are aliases, not parallel systems.

vd3.derivation: Rem-rounded small spacing step (1px rounded to 2px for baseline screen grid)

spacing.$description: Literal pixel spacing aliases mirroring space.fib-* · --vd3-spacing-* (legacy --vd-spacing-*). Values <= 12px carry C-01; >= 13px are literal Fibonacci Class A.

vd3.derivation: Rem-rounded small pixel spacing step (1px rounded to 2px)

line.$description: Border/line weights — Fibonacci 1/2/3/5px (class A). NEW IN 1.0: v1.9 ships only --vd-border-width: 1px (F3-5 gap confirmed by audit).

focus.$description: Dual-ring focus indicator geometry — tokenized in 1.0.2 from the CSS-only --vd3-focus-ring-* contract (foundations/focus.md, FOC-001…FOC-004). CSS mapping: focus.ring.* -> --vd3-focus-ring-*.

vd3.reason: Alias of the semantic focus role (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 >= 3:1)
Alias of the semantic canvas role

icon.$description: Iconography contract (foundations/icons.md, new in 1.1). Sizes are Fibonacci steps F_7..F_10 (Class A) on a 16px rem base; stroke width is phi (Class A); color leaves are semantic-role aliases only. Resolves the token-audit open unknown 'Phosphor icon sizing steps' (docs/token-audit.md). CSS mapping per conventions/naming.md: icon.* -> --vd3-icon-* (legacy alias --vd-icon-*).

size.$description: Icon box sizes — Fibonacci F_7..F_10. Base .vd-icon defaults to md (F_8 = 21px).

vd3.derivation: Fibonacci F_7 = 13; rem value identical to space.fib-13
Fibonacci F_8 = 21; rem value identical to space.fib-21
Fibonacci F_9 = 34; rem value identical to space.fib-34
Fibonacci F_10 = 55; rem value identical to space.fib-55

stroke.$description: Outline icon stroke — SVG stroke-width in user units of the icon viewBox (Phosphor outline/regular weight is the reference).

outline.$description: --vd3-icon-stroke-outline · 1.618 = phi rounded to 3 decimals; matches the select chevron in components/form.css

color.$description: Icon ink — semantic-role aliases only; components never consume primitives directly (foundations/color.md).

critical.$description: --vd3-icon-color-critical · error status icons, always paired with text (WCAG 1.4.1)

vd3.derivation: Alias for space.fib-5 (rem-rounded 8px small spacing step)

density.$description: Density scale factors — exactly two modes (resolves docs/research-brief.md open question Q4; new in 1.1, foundations/density.md). Runtime hook data-density="compact" on the root element sets --vd3-density-scale and remaps every --vd3-space-fib-* to calc(<base> * var(--vd3-density-scale)) in tokens.css. Spacing only: containers, breakpoints, type, line weights, radii are structural and never scaled. CSS mapping: density.scale.* -> --vd3-density-scale-*; density.multiplier -> --vd3-density-scale.

vd3.reason: Identity no-op default — a missing data-density hook must never change rendering; conventional-by-design

compact.$description: Compact mode · --vd3-density-scale-compact · activated by [data-density="compact"] on the root element

vd3.derivation: phi^(-1/2) = 1/sqrt(phi) = 0.7862 — reciprocal of the sqrt(phi) typography modular step, applied to spacing

vd3.reason: Defaults to comfortable identity (1); overridden by [data-density="compact"]

radius.$description: Radii are Fibonacci steps (class A) — v1.9 --vd-radius-fib-2/3/5/8/13/21 confirmed. v1.9 also ships conventional --vd-border-radius-sm/md/lg/xl (4/8/12/16px, class B utility aliases).

full.$description: Pill — shape semantic, not a scale step. Registered exception C-04.

shadow.$description: Elevation ladder — v1.9 fib pairs confirmed in vd3-core.css: 1/2 (--vd-shadow-sm), 2/3 (--vd-shadow), 3/5 (--vd-shadow-md fib variant), 8/13 (--vd-shadow-lg fib), 13/21 (--vd-shadow-xl fib), 21/34 (--vd-shadow-2xl). Values below are the real light-theme composites; dark theme swaps alpha (#...4d/#...80). v1.9 ALSO ships conventional sm/md/lg/xl (tokens.json) — class B aliases under shadow.named.

glow.$description: Glow blur intensities — remapped from v1.9 arithmetic 10/20/30px (un tokenized, component classes) to Fibonacci 8/13/21 (Q2 decision; class A). NEW tokenization in 1.0.

z.$description: Stacking ladder — v1.9 --vd-z-* confirmed: named, conventional 10-step from 1000 (class B, Q3 decision: platform/debugging seam, tokenized). base is new in 1.0.

vd3.reason: Native dialog and modal window layer

container.$description: Container widths — v1.9 --vd-container-* confirmed: 521/610/987/1364/1597px. Fibonacci and Lucas, both class A.

breakpoint.$description: Breakpoints — v1.9 --vd-breakpoint-* confirmed. Class B: conventional platform values (familiarity beats math, PRN-3).

font.$description: Font family stacks · --vd3-font-family-*. Runtime [data-font] overrides --vd-font-family-{sans,mono} which --vd3-font-family-* unwrap.

vd3.reason: Conventional system-matched sans-serif stack with Ubuntu default

mono.$value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

vd3.reason: Conventional monospace stack with JetBrains Mono default

type.$description: Type scale — v1.9 --vd-font-size-* confirmed: static steps xs..base plus fluid clamp() for lg..6xl (with lg-static..4xl-static mobile lower-bound fallbacks; max bounds are phi multiples: 1.25/1.625/2.0625/2.625/3.3125/4.25/5.375rem). Class A.

vd3.reason: Static mobile lower-bound fallback for fluid modular step lg
Static mobile lower-bound fallback for fluid modular step xl
Static mobile lower-bound fallback for fluid modular step 2xl
Static mobile lower-bound fallback for fluid modular step 3xl
Static mobile lower-bound fallback for fluid modular step 4xl

leading.$description: phi line-heights — confirmed present in v1.9 css (--vd-line-height-tight 1.236 = 2/phi, snug 1.382, normal 1.5, relaxed 1.618 = phi). v1.9 also ships conventional 1.25/1.5/1.75/2 (class B aliases).

vd3.reason: Conventional double line spacing for editorial reading

tracking.$description: Six tracking tokens — v1.9 --vd-letter-spacing-* confirmed. Class B: conventional em steps.

vd3.reason: Conventional optical tightening for large display titles
Conventional optical tightening for section headings
Subtle optical spacing for small caps / buttons
Expanded optical tracking for badges / labels

motion.$description: Fibonacci duration ladder — v1.9 --vd-duration-55..987 confirmed (plus --vd-duration-0). Named aliases below are the v1.9 named layer (instant..slowest = 89..987ms, aliasing the ladder). CSS mapping: motion.* -> --vd-duration-*. Class A.

easing.$description: Golden easing set — v1.9 --vd-ease-* confirmed; control points are 1/φ (0.618) and 1/φ² (0.382). Class A. CSS mapping: easing.* -> --vd-ease-*.

aspect.$description: Golden aspect ratio tokens — Class A.

glass.$description: Frosted glass tokens — blur radii, tint opacities, and saturation boosts adhering to the C-02 Convergence Zone.

blur-lg.$description: 20px · C-02 · Convergence Zone soft-cap for cards / popovers

blur-xl.$description: 26px · C-02 · Convergence Zone hard-cap for modal backdrops / drawers
